content.short: PFP Series that will get you WL for our Storybook that will be a physical copy.
content.description:
Our PFP Series will give you an automatic Whitelist Spot for our first Storybook. Out of the 777 PFPs there will be 5 specific characters within the storybook and if you mint any of those 5 you will be able to help create the characters archetype.

As the story continues more of our PFPs will be added to the storybook in future editions. PFP holders will also receive special airdrops, and have an input in the future direction as we move forward. Our ultimate goal is to grow together, add value to our community, be a positive force, and advocate for the Cardano space.
